expectations.text: Explains the temporary modification of Category XI(b) retains 'analyze and produce information from' and 'software' within the control text
expectations.evidence: "a temporary rule retained specific language — 'analyze and produce information from' and 'software' — within XI(b)'s scope".

expectations.text: States it was extended through August 30, 2028 (final rule, 91 FR 55461, August 2026)
expectations.evidence: "the XI(b) temporary modification... has been extended through August 30, 2028 (91 FR 55461)".

expectations.text: Gives the origin: the 2014 Category XI rewrite created ambiguity that could exclude certain intelligence-analytics software; the temporary modification preserves the pre-2015 scope
expectations.evidence: Origin vague: "rather than letting export-control-reform-era narrowing remove it" — never identifies the 2014 Category XI rewrite ambiguity or preservation of the pre-2015 scope.

expectations.text: Advises classifying against the current (modified) XI(b) text today — the software remains ITAR-controlled if described
expectations.evidence: "Does the software... 'analyze and produce information from'... If yes, it is enumerated under the current (extended) XI(b) text"; "treat XI(b) intelligence-analytics software exactly as ITAR-controlled through at least August 30, 2028".

expectations.text: Recommends monitoring for the permanent resolution and considering a Commodity Jurisdiction request where edge-case
expectations.evidence: "revisit before that date since further extension, permanent codification, or lapse are all still possible"; "strong candidate for a formal Commodity Jurisdiction (CJ) determination (22 CFR § 120.4)".
